To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
urea treatment of wheat straw and urease supplementation of urea-treated wheat straw improved the nutritive value and digestibility of wheat straw by sheep.
urea and urease addition to wheat straw improved its intake and utilization by sheep.
the addition of urea or urea plus urease to wheat straw significantly improved its digestibility and intake by sheep.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of urea treatment and urea supplementation of straw on its nutritive value.
the use of urea and urease as additives to improve the nutritive value and utilization of straw by ruminants.
the use of urea and SBM as a potential method to improve the nutritive value and the utilization of straw by sheep.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

urea treatment is more beneficial than urea-supplementation with SBM as a potential urease source, and this is due to the fact that the latter treatment is not effective enough in urea hydrolyzing process.
ammoniation with urease and with urea had a similar effect on the utilization of wheat straw by sheep.
ammoniation with urease (SBM) has no additional effect on straw utilization by lambs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
urea treatment of wheat straw improved its utilization by lambs, and that urea hydrolytic activity of SBM was not a limiting factor in this study.
the addition of SBM to wheat straw as urease source did not affect the utilization of wheat straw by sheep.
urea treatment improved straw nutritive value, but the effect was less than that obtained when urea was used to ammoniate the straw.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the addition of urea to straw, either alone or in the presence of soybean meal, can improve its nutritive value for sheep.
urea treatment of straw is more beneficial than urease treatment in terms of improving the digestibility of straw by ruminants.
ammoniation of wheat straw with urea is more effective in increasing the nutritive value than urease supplementation.
